sentences.en: I ran through the textbook once more before the examination.
sentences.zh: 考试前我再次翻阅了教材。

sentences.en: I gave him three textbooks in exchange for his help.
sentences.zh: 我用三本教科书跟他交换帮助。

sentences.en: He said to me: "I lost my textbook yesterday morning".
sentences.zh: 他说：‘昨天早上我把教科书弄丢了。’

senses.zh: 教科书式的，标准的，典型的
